title: Controlled Training-Budget Matched Empirical Study (2,000 / 5,000 / 10,000 slots)
primary_question: Does increasing the training budget from 2,000 to 5,000 and 10,000 slots allow the Joint RIS/FJ DRL controller to overcome its exploration deficit and achieve a statistically significant utility or secrecy gain over Fixed RIS?
primary_metric: Frozen evaluation system utility difference (Joint minus Fixed) at 10,000 slots
secondary_metrics: Frozen evaluation secrecy rate difference (Joint minus Fixed) at 10,000 slots
Paired utility and secrecy differences at 2,000 and 5,000 slots
Finite-grid theoretical utility gap reduction vs budget
RIS configuration q distribution vs budget
Bob QoS outage and secrecy outage fractions
